description: This file defines classes and methods related to recording and generating XML representations of module data and workflows in an OpenERP (Odoo) environment, including a proxy class for intercepting object execution and a core class for managing module record data.

classes.name: recording_objects_proxy
classes.description: A proxy class that intercepts object method calls and logs queries and workflows when recording is enabled.

classes.name: base_module_record
classes.description: A class managing module record data, capable of creating, copying, and generating XML representations of records and workflows.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Intercepts object method calls, logs query data if recording is active.

methods.name: exec_workflow
methods.description: Intercepts workflow execution calls, logs workflow data if recording is active.

methods.name: _create_id
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for a new record based on its name and model.

methods.name: _get_id
methods.description: Retrieves the internal ID or module-qualified name for a given record ID.

methods.name: _create_record
methods.description: Creates an XML element representing a record with its fields and relations.

methods.name: get_copy_data
methods.description: Retrieves data from an existing record to facilitate copying.

methods.name: _create_function
methods.description: Creates an XML element representing a function (e.g., menu creation).

methods.name: _generate_object_xml
methods.description: Generates XML elements for create, write, menu_create, or copy operations.

methods.name: _generate_assert_xml
methods.description: Placeholder for generating assertion XML, currently unimplemented.

methods.name: generate_xml
methods.description: Generates the complete XML document representing recorded data and workflows.
